disagreements.rationale: The `unsafe { ... }` block around `enter_wasm`/`catch_traps` is removed and the body is otherwise unchanged, so the same operations are now performed without an unsafe block. No unsafe operation is shown in the new snippet.
`CStr::from_ptr` is replaced by the safe `CStr::from_bytes_until_nul`, which also rejects non-null-terminated input. Only a separate i8-to-u8 slice cast remains unsafe.

Both unsafe FFI calls to `dma_max_mapping_size`/`dma_get_max_seg_size` remain; the change only caps the resulting size with `min`. No safe replacement for the foreign calls is available in this frame.
`NonNull::new_unchecked(new_tail_ptr)` is replaced by storing the already-constructed `new_tail_node` NonNull value, removing the unsafe constructor. The replacement expression itself is safe.
